modules.module_title: Perform and demonstrate routine upkeep of plantation area

pcs.pc_description: clear unwanted weeds, grasses, and debris from the plantation area using appropriate tools
demonstrate proper mulching techniques to retain soil moisture
loosen soil around the plant base to enhance aeration and root growth
carry out irrigation activities as per schedule, ensuring optimum water supply
ensure plantation paths and surroundings are kept clean and safe
follow work instructions to execute upkeep tasks within given timelines
use tools and implements safely while performing upkeep operations
dispose of weeds and plant residues in an eco-friendly manner

modules.module_title: Apply and ensure soil and nutrient management practices

pcs.pc_description: demonstrate preparation of organic manure or compost for soil enrichment
apply manure/fertilizers around plant roots at recommended doses and intervals

recognize soil erosion-prone areas and apply corrective measures
follow instructions for safe storage, handling, and application of fertilizers
maintain records of fertilizer/manure application as per instructions
display awareness of sustainable practices to minimize environmental impact
use protective gear while handling chemical fertilizers, if applicable

modules.module_title: Identify and conduct basic plant health maintenance

pcs.pc_description: regularly observe plantation for signs of pest or disease infestation
identify common symptoms such as leaf spots, wilting, or discoloration
perform basic removal of infected leaves/branches under supervision
apply safe and prescribed plant protection methods (e.g., neem oil, fungicide spray)
report major pest/disease problems to supervisors promptly
maintain the cleanliness of tools and equipment used for plant health management
ensure safety measures while handling plant protection inputs
keep the plantation environment conducive to healthy plant growth
